evidence: Has the Wallet label and modifies src/wallet/wallet.cpp and src/wallet/walletdb.cpp to fix transaction chain state loading.
rationale: Fixes a wallet crash caused by an assertion failure (`!wtx.isConfirmed()`) when updating transaction states against an advancing chain before AttachChain is complete. This race condition left transaction states inconsistent with the active chain and risked allowing confirmed transactions to be incorrectly eligible for abandonment.
